qualification.mode: byte-asserted manual original-instruction translations; NOT native wire execution

source_boundaries: No hardware AES or ROM-helper execution
No proven raw datagram receive limit

model_policy.defaults: Each selected descriptor starts at source-table literal0; synthetic control/report frames start at chosen raw0. Metadata literal defaults from0x41a8d6 are retained, including verV3.0.0 and bc gree. Raw room/filter/water/air/error readouts default0 and remain stable absent explicit synthetic report updates.
model_policy.physical: No calibrated climate/thermal-room behavior is inferred. Model all known getters as raw cache/readouts instead of omitting them because a physical sensor/mainboard is absent.
model_policy.key: Use existing seeded device identity machinery to choose16 alphanumeric characters; preserve key across bind/rebind and stable-seed restart. Actual source loads/generates/persists16chars; research probe fixed0123456789AbCdEf is only a fixture, not a universal production profile key.
model_policy.clock: Explicit synthetic clock source. Original eight-byte time record is [yearLE16,sec,min,hour,weekday,day,month]; real getter formats it. Model clock-setting updates the raw clock input; do not mistake the probe fixed epoch for vendor startup time.
model_policy.rssi: Explicit raw signed8 provider, probe raw206->-50. Synthetic constant/default is policy, not measured RF.
model_policy.metadata_unknowns: Metadata mid getter uses separate0xde3a0, not discovery0xe1ca0; metadata vender separate0xdd138 is not root vendor literal1. Probe fixtures are empty strings. Do not fabricate aliases. User-defined synthetic name is permitted but source name-write branch is accepted/no-effect.
model_policy.report_lifecycle: For bounded model command completion, choose one explicit mainboard policy: reflect masked encoded controls into matching report payload positions, then run source report projection. Read-only/environmental bytes stay stable. Keep requested ACK intact even when effective cache differs. Real external mainboard delay/calibration is not claimed.
model_policy.metadata_writes: lat/lon nonempty strings<=10 copy RAM and read back. host<=20 writes config buffer; scheduler host getter stays old until an explicit modeled scheduler/config refresh. time setter uses raw-clock IO boundary. ReportClientID builds pending30-byte buffer7e7e126a+ASCII and is omitted from command p/opt reply; no invented ReportClientID getter or physical delivery success.
model_policy.reset: Per-device fresh cache/control/report state; key stable by seed/persisted identity. No shared mutable cache between family instances. Metadata/runtime state persistence beyond source-backed key is an explicit chosen model policy.

safe_deviations: Strict bounded JSON strings/numbers and no NaN/Infinity
Reject oversized property names and unsafe/mismatched batches before any mutation
Reject malformed base64 and invalid/out-of-range padding instead of native underflow/memory writes
Require complete valid time input rather than source partial sscanf acceptance
No actual flash/upgrades or physical serial side effects

Chosen safe model limits: encrypted pack string1460 bytes, response1460 bytes,64fields, property19UTF8bytes, scalar strings/numeric lexemes64UTF8bytes, JSON numeric magnitude<=uint64, signed32uid, cid63bytes/tcid31bytes. No native receive-limit claim.
Synthetic raw clock fixed at2026-01-01 until complete valid set-time; no wall-clock drift. RSSI byte206 is a chosen raw provider.
After each command immediate synthetic board echo runs source projections. Cache-only sensor writes can be ACKed then replaced by unchanged raw reports. No physical serial delivery.

numeric_lexemes.evidence: Original canonical C 11791..11815 at0x420dfc and atoi0x49641c; static source classification, not additional executed-native wire cases.
numeric_lexemes.classification: Unquoted tokens starting minus are type1 unless a literal decimal point changes the type to4. Exponent markers alone do not change the type. Quoted numeric-looking strings remain type0.
numeric_lexemes.conversion: Preserve the original numeric token until decimal-prefix atoi with RV32 wrap. 1e3 and1e-3 ACK1; 4294967295e0 ACK-1; -1.0e3 ACK-1. These are not float-value conversions.
numeric_lexemes.safe_negative_boundary: Reject the complete ordinary batch for type1 tokens such as -1e3 or -0 instead of reproducing source skipped-value/cardinality hazards. A quoted -1e3 remains a string and ACKs-1.
numeric_lexemes.strict_json: The shared parser still rejects NaN, Infinity, nonfinite exponent overflow, duplicate members and malformed JSON before mutation. Only the Hi3861 inner decoder opts into lexical numeric tokens; outer envelopes and other families retain normal Python numeric values.

metadata.name: name
metadata.semantics: Getter returns root-context name at0xde440. Setter recognizes name and returns success without storing; this native no-op must be labeled, not implemented as a fictional rename.

metadata.name: time
metadata.semantics: Getter reads an8-byte time record and formats %04d-%02d-%02d %02d:%02d:%02d. Setter parses %4d-%2d-%2d %2d:%2d:%2d, tests sscanf result>0 (not six), then invokes real time setter0x41b0ce. Safe model should require all six valid fields rather than reproduce uninitialized partial parse.

metadata.name: host
metadata.semantics: Setter requires nonempty length<=20 and copies into0xe0f90. Getter reads scheduler host0xde4b8, not the same address; immediate equality is not established without the intervening scheduler update.

metadata.name: lat
metadata.semantics: Nonempty length<=10; string copied to0xe1c80 and getter returns the same bytes. No geographic numeric validation in this branch.

metadata.name: lon
metadata.semantics: Nonempty length<=10; string copied to0xe1c8c and getter returns the same bytes. No geographic numeric validation in this branch.

metadata.name: ReportClientID
metadata.semantics: Write path parses nested opt and p arrays and requires equal lengths. Only string type0 matching ReportClientID is accepted; calls0x41c5f0 to build a7e7e126a binary message and marks0xe0ff2=1. There is no corresponding metadata getter branch; a status query falls through to unknown-name zero.

metadata.name: bc
metadata.semantics: Reads root-context0xde340 and calls original0x41f51e: clears64-byte output, then formats each input byte with literal%02x at0x4a0700, advancing2 output bytes per source byte. Thus status bc is lower-case hex of root bc bytes, not base64 and not identical to discovery bc. For example source bytes gree ->67726565. Oversize formatting must be bounded safely rather than reproducing native overrun/log-only behavior.
